items.title: Vaxcyte (PCVX) Brings In Pharma Veterans As Its Big Test Nears
items.summary: On September 3, Vaxcyte (NASDAQ:PCVX) announced two new C-suite hires and moved up the date for its most important looming catalyst. The company said it now expects topline safety, tolerability and immunogenicity data from the VAX-31 adult Phase 3 OPUS-1 trial by the end of October, narrowing guidance that had previously pointed only to sometime […]

items.title: Is Pfizer's New Business Big Enough To Carry The Old One?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) trades at about 95% of its 52-week high. The business that has to justify that price, the medicines it has launched and acquired, is still only about a fifth of the company. The stock returned roughly 24% over the past year against about 17% for the S&P 500, so investors have so far given the handoff the benefit of the doubt. It is a large bet on a small slice.

items.title: Should You Judge JNJ Stock Without STELARA?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) has been a rewarding stock to hold, up about 53% over the past year against about 17% for the S&P 500. The change worth noticing over that stretch is quieter than the price. Management said sales still rose 5.6% despite a STELARA drag of about 460 basis points. Management is encouraging investors to evaluate the company's underlying momentum by presenting growth rates that exclude STELARA alongside its reported figures.

items.title: Will Korlym Continue to Aid CORT's Growth Through the Rest of 2026?
items.summary: Corcept's Korlym sales rise 6.2% in H1 2026 as demand grows, while Lifyorli's launch offers a path to diversify revenues.

items.title: How a Roth IRA Can Keep Thousands More of Your High-Yield Dividend Income Compounding
items.summary: Where you hold a high-yield dividend stock matters almost as much as which one you pick, and for ordinary-income payers like BDCs and REITs, the wrong account quietly erodes a portion of every distribution before it ever compounds.

items.title: 1 Stock Under $50 to Target This Week and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Stocks trading between $10 and $50 can be particularly interesting as they frequently represent businesses that have survived their early challenges. However, investors should remain vigilant as some may still have unproven business models, leaving them vulnerable to the ebbs and flows of the broader market.

items.summary: Prostate cancer awareness spotlights Pfizer's Xtandi, Novartis' Pluvicto and clinical-stage programs from Candel and Janux.

items.title: Merck Stock: Is The $70 Billion Pipeline Worth the Premium?
items.summary: A powerful drug pipeline is fueling a stock trend that ranks in the top 6% of US stocks worth more than $1 billion, but the ticket price for investors is steep and the clock is ticking on its biggest star.
